Four supplied complete repairs assessed with full and shortened availability; only the relief finish changes.
Changing only priority reuses the same feasibility evaluation and mandatory operating facts.
Applied availability edits withhold a current summary until recalculation.
A complete calculation with no passing supplied repair remains distinct from an unavailable calculation.

The activity-based Complete roster view compares a selected service position across the supplied repairs; all nine positions remain available for inspection and actual agreement/publication stays external.
Native mobile view has no horizontal page overflow.
